title: Counit-normalized localization of ordinary completed scalar balancing
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, an embedding $i:E\to F$, and a scheme $W$. Use the completed integral coefficient sheaves and constant integral coefficient sheaves of [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $H$ and $U$ be restriction from completed $E$ and $F$ coefficients to constant coefficients, with their exact additive structures [def-pur-native-constant-support-model]. Let $T$ be ordinary constant scalar extension, and $G$ ordinary completed scalar extension, with the specified universal derived counit [def-pur-strict-scalar-mate-evaluation-data, def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. For every ordinary natural isomorphism $\beta:T\circ H\simeq U\circ G$, there is a unique natural isomorphism $\chi:D(T)\circ D(H)\simeq D(U)\circ LG$ such that, for every complex $P$ of completed $E$ modules [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction], the composite of $\chi_{QP}$, the image under $D(U)$ of the complex counit of $LG$, and the exact-functor factorization of $U$, equals the exact-functor factorization of $H$, then that of $T$, then the localization of the termwise map $\beta_P$. The equation is exactly the one displayed in the attached Lean statement. The ordinary comparison $\beta$ is retained, rather than replaced by an unrelated isomorphism.

proof.text: The finite-free constant extension is exact by baseTensor_exact in [def-pur-strict-scalar-mate-evaluation-data]. Restriction U reflects isomorphisms because its underlying abelian sheaf is unchanged. Since U is exact, it reflects finite limits and colimits. Transfer preservation along beta to G composed with U, and reflect it along U. Thus G is exact. This works for identity field extensions and the zero complex as well.

proof.text: The universal left-derived counit of an exact functor is invertible on every complex. Apply the proved exactScalarCochainIso helper of [def-pur-finite-scalar-coordinate-data] to G and its specified left-derived functor. Expanding that isomorphism on a complex gives precisely the specified complex counit, including the quotient-to-homotopy and homotopy-to-derived factorizations.

proof.text: Apply the proved localizedBalancing helper of [def-pur-strict-scalar-mate-evaluation-data] to H, T, G, U, the counit isomorphism, and beta. Localization of the ordinary square constructs chi. The exact-factorization isomorphisms and derived counits give the displayed equation. Uniqueness follows by localization extensionality after cancelling those invertible factors. Substitute the complex-counit equation from the previous step pointwise to obtain the stated normalization.

theorem completedScalarBalancing_existsUnique (W : Scheme.{u})
    [hHA : (constantRestriction l E W).Additive]
    [hHL : PreservesFiniteLimits (constantRestriction l E W)]
    [hHC : PreservesFiniteColimits (constantRestriction l E W)]
    [hUA : (constantRestriction l F W).Additive]
    [hUL : PreservesFiniteLimits (constantRestriction l F W)]
    [hUC : PreservesFiniteColimits (constantRestriction l F W)]
    [(pbcExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W) ⋙
      constantRestriction l F W).Additive]
    (β : constantRestriction l E W ⋙ pbcExtend (constantMap l E F i W) ≅
      pbcExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W) ⋙ constantRestriction l F W) :
    ∃! χ : (constantRestriction l E W).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ baseTensor l E F i W ≅
        pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W) ⋙
          (constantRestriction l F W).mapDerivedCategory,
      ∀ P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ,
        χ.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
            (constantRestriction l F W).mapDerivedCategory.map
              (pbcComplexCounit (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W) P) ≫
            (constantRestriction l F W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
              (((pbcExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W)).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
          (baseTensor l E F i W).map
              ((constantRestriction l E W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
            baseTensorCounit l E F i W
              (((constantRestriction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex β (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)
